reviews.classification: cross-world proposal palette with tiered source evidence
reviews.disposition: Retain D-C1/D-C2, GC1–GC5, HC1–HC10, X-C1–X-C4, NC1–NC30, NE1–NE3 and CE1–CE3 as a reusable question palette with explicit T/Q/S/P/D source labels. Three short primary windows qualify only their actual exposition/statements; neither all-source coverage nor observed shutdown/restart, complete temporal travel or soul ontology follows. Source-qualified prior audit reuse remains at its original range; publication snippets, wiki/community leads and hypothetical comparisons are not primary scene proof. Shared clocks, control, memory, disclosure, custody and per-output aftermath are useful distinctions without a universal magic schema or every-theoretical-pair test. D-C2’s wait-for-demonstrated-consumers phrasing is qualified by later AD51: design a reasonable shared seam from known world sources first, then validate/revise with another world. This does not impose an implemented-two-world embargo. Existing broad/niche/cross-book folds already preserve the substantive uptake in the lead brief and family map.
reviews.evidence: Complete three-round palette read, repairing clipped final CE/discovery spans. Existing receiving broad/niche/cross-book sections inspected; current AD51 digest checked. No primary text/web read.
reviews.reopen: A selected operation with consequential uncertainty reopens its exact source range/composition, not an automatic thirty-book audit.

reviews.classification: mixed accepted direction, proposed execution workflow and dated evidence
reviews.disposition: The title’s blanket “nothing here is accepted” is qualified by its own later AD48 paragraph: separate capable runtime implementers and mechanism-led delivery are accepted direction; the exact pipeline, cadence, depth levels, thresholds, estimates and standing-check proposals are not blanket adopted. Current PROJECT/VISION_DIGEST supersede “build ch23 next” and the old ch32 gate as present queue instructions. Keep authoring/native proof serial where checkpoints actually depend, source-fixed seams eligible for parallel work under current ownership and authorization, and mechanism+display leading its consumers. A 140M-token upper bound is not a forecast; historical boot/import timings and 20MB/twice-time thresholds are provisional, not a demonstrated performance cause or universal chunking gate. Canon-stage reachability and calibrated source amounts remain distinct from stage-count progress and adjustable ordinary-time depth. Preserve T1–T8 and M/D/P/R/C/$/H/I/B dispositions: generated-string checks must inspect built data; stable fact keys and actual actor/seat joins; durable retrievable bundle identity; currency/holder/fee scope; literal current-candidate review import; handoff ledgers and single pack writer. T7 is marked built, so keep its helper history rather than request it anew, without certifying it by this review. Locator existence is structural: a valid paragraph can still be the wrong evidence, as the ch66 income correction demonstrates. One previous-checkpoint runner path does not establish equivalent bytes, joined uninterrupted campaign or all-hop replay. Content-only rule/build cadence is a proposal and cannot replace AD36/AD43 runtime/consumer proof. Old private proof bundle and running-probe state are historical, not current bytes/workers. No commit, reader dispatch, source expansion or chain replay is authorized by reviewing this workflow.
reviews.evidence: Complete workflow read in bounded ranges after clipped combined output; current focus and standing campaign/AD51 digest inspected. Original private probe/cast/runner files not reread.
reviews.reopen: Only the current campaign owner selects future mechanisms, depth, proof and dispatch under live authorization. Do not act on stale next-window/worker claims.
